pumgye.case.ambiguous_target: Give either permission and information_class, or resource and action.
pumgye.case.assurance_out_of_range: AAL must be 0–3 (0 for workload and Kubernetes API subjects).
pumgye.case.invalid_name: Identifiers must be 1–128 characters of letters, digits and _.:-.
pumgye.case.missing_network_evidence: This subject kind requires ip and guard evidence.
pumgye.case.unexpected_network_evidence: Kubernetes API subjects take no ip or guard evidence.
pumgye.case.unsupported_combination: This subject kind supports only resource and action targets.
pumgye.detail.action_unknown: Action {action} is not defined for the resource.
pumgye.detail.allow_set_expired: Allow bindings exist but none is within its validity window.
pumgye.detail.allow_set_live: Live allow bindings match the request zones.
pumgye.detail.allow_set_none: No allow binding covers this service.
pumgye.detail.allow_set_zone_mismatch: Allow bindings exist but none allows the request's network zones.
pumgye.detail.assurance_below_required: Presented AAL{presented} is below the required AAL{required}.
pumgye.detail.assurance_out_of_range: Presented AAL{presented} is outside the supported range AAL0–AAL3.
pumgye.detail.assurance_satisfied: Presented AAL{presented} meets the required AAL{required}.
pumgye.detail.catalog_resolved: The target resolved to permission {permission} and label {label}.
pumgye.detail.ceiling_matched: The most specific network ceiling for the address was selected.
pumgye.detail.ceiling_no_match: No network ceiling of this service covers the address.
pumgye.detail.class_missing_subject: No role assigned to the subject includes information class {requested}.
pumgye.detail.class_removed_by_network: The subject's roles include {requested}, but the matched network rule does not.
pumgye.detail.class_unknown: Information class {requested} is not in the policy vocabulary.
pumgye.detail.clearance_exceeded: No template granting the permission is cleared for the label.
pumgye.detail.clearance_granted: A granting template's clearance covers the label.
pumgye.detail.context_matched: The service authorization context matches this entrypoint.
pumgye.detail.context_mismatch: The service uses authorization context {context}, but this entrypoint requires {required}.
pumgye.detail.explicit_denied: Deny binding {binding} matches; deny overrides every allow.
pumgye.detail.fence_satisfied: Snapshot revision {revision} is serving and satisfies the minimum revision {minimum_revision}.
pumgye.detail.guard_denied: Sumunjang evidence is deny; a Sumunjang denial overrides every grant.
pumgye.detail.guard_not_enforced: The service requires enforced Sumunjang evidence, but the evidence is {evidence}.
pumgye.detail.guard_not_required: Sumunjang evidence is {evidence}; this service does not require enforced evidence.
pumgye.detail.membership_unavailable: No fresh signed group membership projection is held; group grants cannot be evaluated.
pumgye.detail.network_matched: The client address matched a network rule.
pumgye.detail.network_no_match: The client address {ip} matched no network rule.
pumgye.detail.not_evaluated: Not evaluated: an earlier stage decided the outcome.
pumgye.detail.permission_missing_subject: No role assigned to the subject grants permission {requested}.
pumgye.detail.permission_removed_by_netw: The subject's roles grant {requested}, but the matched network rule does not.
pumgye.detail.permission_unknown: Permission {requested} is not in the service vocabulary.
pumgye.detail.principal_assurance_invali: Human assurance AAL{aal} is outside the accepted range (AAL1–2 from an adapter, AAL1–3 only with Hopae-sealed evidence).
pumgye.detail.principal_assurance_valid: Human assurance AAL{aal} is within the accepted range.
pumgye.detail.principal_invalid: The Human subject identifier is not canonical (human1: + 64 hex).
pumgye.detail.principal_matched: The principal has bindings directly or through groups.
pumgye.detail.principal_not_bound: No binding names this principal or any of its groups.
pumgye.detail.principal_valid: The Human subject identifier is canonical.
pumgye.detail.resource_not_found: Resource {resource} is not in the catalog.
pumgye.detail.revision_floor: Snapshot revision {revision} is older than the required minimum revision {minimum_revision}.
pumgye.detail.roles_intersected: Effective rights are the subject's roles intersected with the network rule's roles.
pumgye.detail.scope_matched: The requested service matches the resource owner {owner}.
pumgye.detail.scope_mismatch: The requested service {requested} does not own the resource (owner {owner}).
pumgye.detail.snapshot_unavailable: The published snapshot is not serving decisions (unhealthy or expired source).
pumgye.detail.subject_guest_only: Subject {subject} is assigned only the guest role.
pumgye.error.batch_too_large: Too many cases: at most 256 per batch, or 32 with traces.
pumgye.error.candidate_too_large: The candidate policy exceeds the 1 MiB stored-policy limit.
pumgye.error.empty_batch: A batch must contain at least one case.
pumgye.error.invalid_cursor: The audit cursor is out of range.
pumgye.error.invalid_delegated_actor: on_behalf_of must be 1–128 characters of letters, digits and _.:@-.
pumgye.error.invalid_page: Diff limit must be 1–500 and the cursor within range.
pumgye.error.malformed_request: The request body is not valid JSON for this endpoint.
pumgye.error.no_v2_document: No policy version 2 document is published.
pumgye.error.payload_too_large: The request body exceeds the size limit.
pumgye.error.regrant_unknown: The re-grant proposal no longer exists; reload the proposals.
pumgye.error.revision_conflict: The requested revision is not the current policy revision {current_revision}; reload and retry.
pumgye.error.shadow_gate_unsatisfied: The shadow gate is not satisfied: the window has not elapsed or unexplained mismatches exist.
pumgye.hint.assurance_denied: Require step-up authentication to the required AAL.
pumgye.hint.class_denied: Grant the information class through a role, or reclassify the resource.
pumgye.hint.explicit_denied: Remove or narrow the deny binding; deny overrides every allow.
pumgye.hint.guard_denied: Review the Sumunjang rule that matched the client.
pumgye.hint.guard_unavailable: Switch Sumunjang to enforce mode for this listener or restore Sumunjang availability.
pumgye.hint.guest: Assign a role to the subject on this service.
pumgye.hint.network_guest: Add a network rule covering the address, or connect from an allowed network.
pumgye.hint.permission_denied: Grant the permission through a role assigned to the subject and allowed by the network rule.
pumgye.hint.unavailable: Wait for the policy revision to propagate or restore authority health.
pumgye.hint.unknown_action: Map the action to a service permission in the resource catalog.
pumgye.hint.unknown_resource: Add the resource to the catalog or fix the route binding.
pumgye.hint.unknown_service: Check the route's service binding or add the service to the policy.
pumgye.migration.class_compartments: v1 classes were carried as compartments under one base level until the Catalog defines levels.
pumgye.migration.class_not_downward_clos: The role's classes are not downward closed; clearance was narrowed.
pumgye.migration.class_union: v1 combined permissions and classes across roles; v2 checks clearance per template.
pumgye.migration.empty_role: The role grants nothing and was dropped.
pumgye.migration.kubernetes_mapping_reta: The Kubernetes RBAC mapping stays on version 1.
pumgye.migration.legacy_workload: Pod-bound workload kept as a deprecated legacy principal.
pumgye.migration.unresolved_subject_kind: The subject's kind could not be resolved; not migrated.
pumgye.reason.assurance_denied: The presented authentication assurance (AAL) is too low.
pumgye.reason.class_denied: The effective roles do not include the information class of the target.
pumgye.reason.explicit_denied: An explicit deny binding refuses this permission.
pumgye.reason.guard_unavailable: The service requires enforced Sumunjang evidence, but the evidence was observe-only or unavailable.
pumgye.reason.guest: The subject has no role assignment on this service, so it is treated as a guest.
pumgye.reason.network_guest: The client address matches no network rule of this service.
pumgye.reason.permission_denied: The effective roles do not grant the requested permission.
pumgye.reason.unavailable: Pumgye would not decide: the snapshot is not serving or is older than the required revision.
pumgye.reason.unknown_action: The action is not defined for this resource.
pumgye.reason.unknown_resource: The resource is not in the policy catalog.
pumgye.reason.unknown_service: The service is not defined in this policy revision, or the resource belongs to a different service.

pumgye.validation.ambiguous_ceiling: Two ceiling entries of a service share a prefix.
pumgye.validation.assignment_limit: The policy exceeds 65,536 assignments or network rules.
pumgye.validation.binding_effect: An allow binding needs role only; a deny binding needs permissions only.
pumgye.validation.binding_id: Binding IDs must be unique bnd_ identifiers.
pumgye.validation.binding_metadata: Binding metadata has an empty, oversized or control-character value.
pumgye.validation.binding_scope: The binding scope names an unknown or duplicate service.
pumgye.validation.catalog_levels: The Catalog import must list 1–16 classification levels.
pumgye.validation.ceiling_templates: A ceiling lists more than 8 templates or a template twice.
pumgye.validation.clearance_level: The clearance ceiling names a level not in the Catalog.
pumgye.validation.deny_permissions: A deny binding must list permissions or all.
pumgye.validation.duplicate_assigned_rol: An assignment lists the same role twice.
pumgye.validation.duplicate_network: The network CIDR is listed twice.
pumgye.validation.duplicate_parent: A role inherits the same role twice.
pumgye.validation.duplicate_right: A role lists the same right twice.
pumgye.validation.group_capacity: The policy references more than 256 groups.
pumgye.validation.group_reference: GroupRefs must be grp1: followed by 26 lowercase Crockford characters.
pumgye.validation.guest_combined: guest cannot be combined with other roles.
pumgye.validation.guest_reserved: The role name guest is reserved.
pumgye.validation.human_subject: Human subjects must be human1: followed by 64 lowercase hex characters.
pumgye.validation.invalid: The policy is invalid at this location.
pumgye.validation.kubernetes_context: A kubernetes_api service cannot have networks, guard requirements or typed assignments.
pumgye.validation.kubernetes_subject: A kubernetes_api service accepts only k8sapi: subjects.
pumgye.validation.label_collision: A name is used both as a level and as a compartment.
pumgye.validation.network_host_bits: The network CIDR has host bits set.
pumgye.validation.permission_map: permission_map targets a permission not in the service vocabulary.
pumgye.validation.prefix_capacity: Network zones exceed 65,536 prefixes in total.
pumgye.validation.principal_capacity: The policy exceeds 1,048,576 principals with direct bindings.
pumgye.validation.principal_reference: The principal reference does not match its kind (human1:, s_, wk2:).
pumgye.validation.reason_required: Production mode requires a reason for permanent allow bindings.
pumgye.validation.resource_class: The resource references an undefined information class.
pumgye.validation.resource_metadata: Resource name, minimum_aal (0–3) or action count (1–64) is invalid.
pumgye.validation.resource_permission: The action maps to a permission not in the service vocabulary.
pumgye.validation.resource_service: The resource references an undefined service.

pumgye.validation.schema: The document does not match the policy schema (unknown field, wrong type or missing field).
pumgye.validation.service_name_or_role_c: Service name is invalid or it has more than 64 roles.

pumgye.validation.subject_service_grants: More than 64 bindings target one subject on one service.
pumgye.validation.subject_unresolved: The binding names a principal unknown to Hopae.
pumgye.validation.template_name: The template name is invalid or reserved (guest).
pumgye.validation.template_permission: A template permission is invalid or duplicated.
pumgye.validation.template_permissions: A template must grant or inherit permissions (at most 256).
pumgye.validation.too_many_rights: A role lists more than 64 rights.
pumgye.validation.unknown_assigned_role: An assignment references an undefined role.
pumgye.validation.unknown_compartment: A compartment is not in the Catalog vocabulary.
pumgye.validation.unknown_right: A role references a permission or information class not in the vocabulary.
pumgye.validation.unknown_role: An inherited role is not defined in this service.
pumgye.validation.unknown_template: The binding or ceiling references an undefined template.
pumgye.validation.unknown_zone: The zone is not defined in the zone import.
